subject.title: fix(secrets): keep startup alive when TTS SecretRefs are missing

question: Should a missing built-in TTS API-key SecretRef fail open only when no Gateway snapshot is active, or during every startup, reload, and config-write preflight activation?
rationale: The issue establishes the cold-start outage, but current repository contracts intentionally apply fail-fast, atomic snapshot semantics across several activation paths; code review cannot choose the permanent credential policy safely.

options.title: Degrade only on cold startup
options.body: Allow startup without TTS when no active snapshot exists, while reload retains the last-known-good snapshot and config-write preflight remains fail-closed.

options.title: Degrade on every activation
options.body: Accept TTS missing-value warnings during startup, reload, and config-write preflight, then document and test that broader compatibility change explicitly.

options.title: Retain universal fail-fast
options.body: Close the PR and keep all active SecretRefs mandatory for every snapshot activation despite the optional-TTS outage.

recommendation.title: Degrade only on cold startup
recommendation.body: Allow startup without TTS when no active snapshot exists, while reload retains the last-known-good snapshot and config-write preflight remains fail-closed.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes repository-wide secrets activation policy and upgrade behavior beyond the TTS implementation details.
